definitions.gloss: fountain of wisdom; trusted advisor; brain
definitions.explanation: A person who serves as a reliable source of wisdom and good advice, especially someone who advises a leader or organization behind the scenes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{知恵袋|ちえぶくろ}だ。
examples.english: He is the brain of the team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{知恵袋|ちえぶくろ}になって⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I'm in trouble, my grandmother serves as my source of wisdom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{知恵袋|ちえぶくろ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えて→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: He has supported the company for many years as the president's trusted advisor.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "bag of wisdom." Used to describe someone whose knowledge and judgment are relied upon. In historical contexts, it often referred to the strategist or advisor behind a powerful leader. Also known as the name of Yahoo! Japan's Q&A service (Yahoo!{知恵袋|ちえぶくろ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {知恵袋|ちえぶくろ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧ (to play an active role as an advisor)
- {知恵袋|ちえぶくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become an advisor)
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{知恵袋|ちえぶくろ} (the team's brain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {参謀|さんぼう}: strategist, staff officer — more military/organizational
- ⟦{相談役|そうだんやく}→相談役：20958_soudanyaku⟧: advisor, consultant — more formal title
- ブレーン: brain (loanword) — used similarly for trusted advisors
